subject: The GEO Group, Inc.

filing_internal_inconsistency.treatment: Preserve the printed 47.6% ICE share; do not silently force the components to the aggregate.

sec_calendar_2025.ice_less_isap_classification: residual of rounded customer percentages; not a detention-revenue subtotal

activation_bundle.classification: multi-customer, multi-channel corporate bundle; neither ICE revenue nor ICE profit can be derived

revenue_recognition.general: Revenue recognition may differ from invoicing; GEO records a receivable when services are performed.
revenue_recognition.secure_services: Recognized continually as services are performed; generally paid per day per individual or at a fixed monthly rate.
revenue_recognition.managed_only: Recognized similarly to owned/leased secure services, except the customer owns the facility.
revenue_recognition.electronic_monitoring: Recognized as performed; generally paid per occurrence plus a monthly management fee.

geo_transport_uei.interpretation: Does not exclude transportation embedded in parent awards, IGSAs, facility rates, or subcontracts.

different_metric_context_ratios.classification: context ratios and arithmetic difference only; not coverage, attribution, undercount, hidden spending, or missing money

nonadditive_examples.metric: audited ICE revenue to local district
county GEO/ICE pass-through account; sign/direction unresolved
audited fund additions and equal reductions; payer/payee attribution unavailable
mixed ICE and USMS revenue and equal operations expense

north_florida.classification: state cash and federal award-wide outlay are separate metrics and are not CY2025 ICE revenue

open_falsifiers.target: complete GEO CY2025 ICE customer-revenue and contract-to-ledger schedule
funded task orders, outlays, local receipts, fees, invoices, and GEO remittances for six ICE IGSA chains

caveats: Obligations, outlays, local cash, rates, ceilings, and SEC revenue are different measures.
The printed 47.6% ICE share is not exact and does not reconcile to the filing's printed 66.6% three-agency aggregate.
The arithmetic difference between obligations and revenue cannot be assigned to IGSAs or any facility.
Capacity is not guaranteed, occupied, billed, or paid bed-days.
A zero direct action for an affiliate UEI does not exclude embedded or subcontract activity.
North Florida state payments and FEMA award-wide outlays are not joined in the public records recovered here.
